own_solution.law: Reversible adiabatic: W_on = n R T1 (r^(gamma-1) - 1)/(gamma - 1)

T75C2.regime: stop irrelevant while the stated ratio r = 8 is below the stop ratio

T6655.regime: only under the reading of a mechanical stop at ratio 15; the plain reading (piston comes to rest at ratio 15) contradicts the stated ratio 8

defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: T6655 'The piston stops at a compression ratio of 15' plainly states the piston comes to rest at ratio 15, contradicting the stated compression ratio 8; only T75C2's wording ('can be pushed in only until') expresses the intended limit.

counterexamples: Reading T6655 as the final state gives W = 1247.1*(15^0.4 - 1)/0.4 = 6.093 kJ, not 4.045 kJ; at the listed value 20 it would give 1247.1*(20^0.4 - 1)/0.4 = 1247.1*(3.3145-1)/0.4 = 7.216 kJ.
notes: All certified answers verified: base 4.04496 kJ; n = 1.2, 1.8, 2.7 mol give 9.7079, 14.5619, 21.8428 kJ. Volume cancellation via p1V1 = nRT1 is correct. Regime 'r < q' for the stop is correct physics for the limit reading, and all listed limits (12, 15, 20) exceed 8. Minimal pairs T108C/T01D6 and T6B54/T4224 hold, numeral-free twins match. The only defect is the wording of T6655 (shared with the K claim), which I flagged in pass 1 and still judge a contradiction under the plain reading; the item would be valid if T6655 were reworded as a stop or limit (e.g. 'A stop prevents the piston going beyond a compression ratio of 15').
